summary: Game Freak's pre-Pokemon Sega Mega Drive action-platformer, originally Japan-only on cartridge and later made broadly playable through Virtual Console and Nintendo Classics.

entries.title: Pulseman
entries.definitive_edition: SEGA Genesis - Nintendo Switch Online release

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Switch Online Genesis app or Mega Drive hardware/emulation
emulation.notes: Use the Switch Online app for modern save/rewind access; original cartridge is collector-oriented.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Mega Drive presentation with official emulator features.

primary.version: SEGA Genesis - Nintendo Switch Online release
primary.why: Pulseman is available through Nintendo Classics/Switch Online, giving it a current official route with save, rewind, online-share features, and Switch 2 compatibility support; it preserves the Mega Drive game without relying on the closed Wii Shop Channel or rare Japanese cartridge.
primary.how_to_play: Play through the SEGA Genesis - Nintendo Switch Online app with an Expansion Pack membership. Use original Mega Drive hardware or Wii Virtual Console only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is an emulated Mega Drive release, not a remaster.
